_meta.indication: NINLARO is indicated in combination with lenalidomide and dexamethasone for the treatment of patients with multiple myeloma who have received at least one prior therapy.

pivotal_trials.design: Phase 3, randomized, double-blind, multicenter, placebo-controlled study comparing oral ixazomib plus lenalidomide and dexamethasone versus placebo plus lenalidomide and dexamethasone; patients randomized 1:1.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with relapsed and/or refractory multiple myeloma who received 1 to 3 prior lines of therapy.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Progression-free survival (PFS) per independent review committee (IRC) assessment.
pivotal_trials.n: 722 patients randomized (360 ixazomib arm, 362 placebo arm).
pivotal_trials.result: At the 1st interim analysis, median PFS 20.6 months (ixazomib) vs 14.7 months (placebo); stratified HR 0.74 (95% CI 0.59, 0.94), p=0.013.

nct_ctgov.title: A Phase 3 Study Comparing Oral Ixazomib Plus Lenalidomide and Dexamethasone Versus Placebo Plus Lenalidomide and Dexamethasone in Adult Participants With Relapsed and/or Refractory Multiple Myeloma

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%) are diarrhea, constipation, thrombocytopenia, peripheral neuropathy, nausea, peripheral edema, vomiting, and back pain. Diarrhea occurred in 42% vs 36% placebo, constipation 34% vs 25%, nausea 26% vs 21%, vomiting 22% vs 11%, peripheral edema 25% vs 18%, rash 19% vs 11%. Serious adverse reactions in ≥2% included thrombocytopenia (2%) and diarrhea (2%).
target_moa: Ixazomib is an orally bioavailable, small molecule reversible inhibitor of the chymotrypsin-like activity of the beta 5 subunit of the 20S proteasome.

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because it did not raise significant public health questions on the role of the drug.

description.text: Added Limitations of Use restricting NINLARO from the maintenance setting and newly diagnosed multiple myeloma outside controlled trials

citations.quote: **Limitations of Use:** NINLARO is not recommended for use in the maintenance setting or in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma in combination with lenalidomide and dexamethasone outside of controlled clinical trials. (1)

summary.text: NDA 208462 for ixazomib received priority review and had orphan drug designation for multiple myeloma; the drug received traditional (full) approval based on a statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival in the single pivotal Phase 3 trial C16010.
